title: Suspect arrested in Virginia State University shooting that wounded five
dek: Camron Harris, 19, from Henrico, Virginia, was arrested Saturday after a 12-hour manhunt following a shooting near VSU residence halls that wounded five people. Harris, not a student, was found hiding in a dorm closet. Police obtained warrants for four counts of malicious wounding and four counts of firearm use in a felony.
author: The GoCheckMyNews Desk
key_fact: Camron Harris, 19, was arrested after a 12-hour search following a shooting that wounded five people near Virginia State University residence halls early Saturday.
bottom_line: Harris remains in custody pending further charges. The investigation into the circumstances of the shooting and the identities and condition of the victims is ongoing.
body: Camron Harris, 19 years old and from Henrico, Virginia, was arrested Saturday after a 12-hour manhunt following a shooting that wounded five people near Virginia State University residence halls early that morning, according to Fox News reporting. Harris is not a student at the university.

The shooting occurred at approximately 1:28 a.m. at the 3300 block of Boisseau Street, outside VSU residence halls. Of the five wounded, one was in critical condition. Only one of the five victims is a university student, per Fox News reporting.

Police located Harris hiding in a closet inside one of the campus dorm buildings hours after the shooting. Police obtained felony warrants for four counts of malicious wounding and four counts of use of a firearm in the commission of a felony. Authorities stated Harris may face more charges. He is being held without bail at Chesterfield County Jail.

The university implemented a lockdown following the incident, which has since been lifted. VSU announced that "VSU police will maintain an increased presence on campus as the investigation continues." Virginia State University is a state-supported historically Black university located in Ettrick, Virginia, about 25 miles south of Richmond.
